title: hieracium umbellatum subsp. kluchoricum
intro: Hieracium umbellatum subsp. kluchoricum, commonly known as Klucho's hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family, native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Klucho's hawkweed include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
